name: Email Center
description: Compose, batch-send, collect, and audit email with confirmation-first AI tools
author: FengYu

email_accounts_list.description: List configured email accounts. Credentials are never returned.

email_contacts_query.description: Search contacts by text and/or tags for recipient planning.

tagIds.description: Restrict to contacts tagged with any of these ids.

email_send_single.description: Prepare a direct or tag-selected message for confirmation. This call does not send.

email_send_batch.description: Prepare an attachment-matched batch send for confirmation without sending.

recipientGroupTagIds.description: Tags whose members receive per-attachment messages.

ccGroupTagIds.description: Tags whose members are CC'd on every message.

inputDirectory.description: Resolved directory of per-recipient attachment files.

commonAttachments.description: Resolved attachment paths attached to every message.

email_batch_preview.description: Preview the per-recipient plan of a batch send without preparing or sending.

email_send_status.description: Query a prepared or completed send by confirmation id.

email_send_records_query.description: Paginated query over send tasks and per-message delivery records.

email_archive_fetch.description: Collect messages from an IMAP folder into an authorized output directory (synchronous).

email_archive_fetch_start.description: Launch archive collection as a background job and return a jobId immediately; poll email_archive_fetch_status.

email_archive_fetch_status.description: Poll an archive job: drains streamed progress lines since the cursor and returns the final result when done.

cursor.description: Absolute log cursor returned by the previous poll.

email_archive_fetch_cancel.description: Request cancellation of a running archive job by id (domain-level job cancel).

email_archive_query.description: Search paginated archived message metadata without exposing message bodies.

email_imap_folders.description: List the IMAP folders available on a saved account.

confirm_send.description: Confirm and dispatch a previously prepared send by confirmation id.

reject_send.description: Reject and discard a previously prepared send by confirmation id.

email_account_find.description: Find a configured account by id without returning credentials.

email_account_save.description: Create or update an account. The password is accepted, encrypted at rest, and never returned.

password.description: SMTP/IMAP credential secret. Scrubbed from all logs and responses.

email_account_delete.description: Delete a configured account by id.

email_account_set_default.description: Mark a configured account as the default sender.

email_account_test.description: Test the SMTP connection for a saved account without sending mail.

email_account_test_imap.description: Test the IMAP connection for a saved account without fetching mail.

email_contact_save.description: Create or update a contact and assign its tags.

email_tag_save.description: Create or rename a contact tag.

email_tag_delete.description: Delete a contact tag by id.

email_tags_assign.description: Bulk-assign a set of tags to a set of contacts.

email_tags_resolve.description: Resolve the de-duplicated recipient email addresses for a set of tags.

email_contacts_import_preview.description: Dry-run a contact import: report what would be created/merged/skipped without writing.

sourceFile.description: Resolved CSV or Excel source file path.

tagDelimiter.description: Tag delimiter for multi-value cells; 'auto' to sniff.

email_contacts_import_commit.description: Commit a contact import atomically using the same options as the preview.

sourceFile.description: Resolved CSV or Excel source file path.

email_config_find.description: Find a saved batch-send configuration template by id.

email_config_save.description: Create or update a named batch-send configuration template.

email_config_delete.description: Delete a saved batch-send configuration template by id.

email_archive_detail.description: Fetch the full metadata of a single archived message by id (bodies are not exposed).

zh.name: 邮件中心
zh.description: 撰写、批量发送、收取并审计邮件，采用确认优先的 AI 工具

email_accounts_list.description: 列出已配置的邮件账户，不返回凭据。

email_contacts_query.description: 搜索联系人与标签以规划收件人。

email_send_single.description: 准备直发或按标签选择的私信以供确认；此调用不会发送。

email_send_batch.description: 准备附件匹配的批量邮件以供确认，但不发送。

email_send_status.description: 按确认 ID 查询已准备或已完成的发送。

email_archive_fetch.description: 将 IMAP 文件夹中的邮件收集到已授权的输出目录。

email_archive_query.description: 分页搜索已归档邮件元数据，不暴露邮件正文。

email_account_test.description: 测试已保存账户的 SMTP 连接，不发送邮件。

email_account_test_imap.description: 测试已保存账户的 IMAP 连接，不收取邮件。

inputs.description: 按收件人准备的附件文件所在目录。
